sources.title: Flint 40B A2.5B | AI Model | There's An AI For That
sources.snippet: Flint is a 40B-parameter mixture-of-experts coding model from Recursive that activates only 2.5B parameters per token. Built for fast agentic coding on local hardware, it supports context windows up to 512K tokens and runs at over 125 tokens per second on an M4 Pro MacBook Pro. Released with open weights under Apache 2.0.

sources.title: Recursive Flint 40B-A2.5B: The Fast Local Coding Model
sources.snippet: The number that decides whether Recursive Flint 40B-A2.5B is worth your disk space is not 54.9%. It is 2.5. Recursive's first open-weight coding model carries 39.8 billion parameters and wakes up roughly 2.5 billion of them for each token it writes, and almost every other decision in the release — the attention layout, the quantisation recipe, the custom Metal kernel, the inference engine ...
